name: Elica
source:
Elica is the one and only maid at the research facility. She attends to [url=/c1538]Sion’s[/url] personal needs, and is a cheerful older sister to everyone (as you can tell, she also has a tendency to over-dramatize situation). She also possesses the usual skills of a maid: the ability to do laundry, cook good food, brew excellent tea, clean, martial arts, etc. 

[Edited from [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/12/28/review-eden-they-were-only-two-on-the-planet/]Choux's review[/url].]
